basis: Marrow aplasia and hypogammaglobulinemia in 2/2; intellectual disability in 2/2 and hypogonadism in 1/1 support additional axes; pigmentation alone is non-damaging.
Microcephaly and motor delay in 2/4; skeletal anomalies in 2/4. Hyaloid remnants lack documented impairment; elevated TSH alone does not establish endocrine dysfunction.
Inherited steroidogenesis defect causes severe adrenal cortisol deficiency; electrolyte disturbances remain within the endocrine/metabolic axis.
Chronic infectious or allergic inflammation of the sphenoid sinus; headache and dizziness do not establish neurologic damage.
Hereditary cerebellar disease with ataxia and dysarthria in 5/5; dysphagia and ocular motor findings occur in only 1/5.
Benign blood-vessel neoplasm arising in skin; vascular and cutaneous tissue define its origin.
Inheritance umbrella spanning unrelated diseases; no organ or mechanism axis applies uniformly across the group.
Genetic type 2 diabetes; retinopathy, nephropathy and vascular complications are separately diagnosed diseases.
Skeletal dysplasia involving vertebrae, epiphyses, metaphyses and joints, with common osteoarthritis and impaired mobility.
Bone fragility defines disease; dentinogenesis imperfecta affects roughly half or more. Type IV hearing impairment is not reliably above 30%; scleral color is non-damaging.
Inherited retinal degeneration caused by biallelic RAB28 variants; no additional organ disease is established.
Defined as a connective-tissue neoplasm; neural-like differentiation does not establish peripheral nerve origin or damage.
Acute myeloid leukemia is a malignant marrow and blood-cell disease; KIT mutation does not establish another organ axis.
Retinal disease defines syndrome; lung abnormalities and enamel hypoplasia in 2/2; CNS/developmental abnormalities in 1/2. PDA in 1/2 omitted under cap.
Skin blistering and pyloric atresia define disease; urinary tract dysplasia, obstruction and hydronephrosis are frequent (30-79%). Skin infections are secondary.
Isolated foveal developmental abnormality impairs visual acuity; definition excludes concomitant systemic pathology.
Meningeal tumor arising in and occupying the internal auditory canal; both CNS meningeal origin and ear location define the concept.
Neurologic sleep-related movement disorder; repetitive muscle contractions do not establish skeletal muscle damage.
Urofacial syndrome causes dysfunctional bladder emptying, urinary obstruction and upper urinary tract damage; secondary UTIs are separate infections.
Intellectual disability and skeletal defects define syndrome; microdontia in 11/11 and gingival overgrowth in 8/8. Recurrent sinusitis and otitis are separate infections.
Benign adipose neoplasm arising from renal parenchyma or capsule; renal location determines the organ axis.
Inherited bone remodeling disorder characterized by multiple focal areas of osteosclerosis.
Malignant tumor arising in the superior vena cava wall; smooth-muscle histology does not imply skeletal muscle disease or infection.
Severe intellectual disability and thoracic skeletal anomalies define syndrome; bilateral cleft lip affects oral structure in the single reported patient (1/1).
Inherited subcutaneous fat loss with metabolic dysfunction; associated steatosis need not impair hepatic function, and steatotic liver disease is separately diagnosed.
